# Jack-o-turnip

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_jackoturnip | Source: Workbench | Season: Halloween | Usage: Resin, -fueled light source. | Crafting Materials: Turnip x4, Resin x2 | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Chop, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

The Jack-o-turnip is a light source.
It can hold up to 6 Resin at once. With 1/6 fuel, a Jack-o-turnip will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity, it should burn for 33 hours and 20 minutes. This duration is the same for the Standing iron torch, Sconce, Standing green-burning iron torch and Standing blue-burning iron torch, and lasts longer than the Standing wood torch.

## Availability

The Jack-o-turnip cannot be built year-round. It can be built only during the Halloween season, 1 October – 6 November. Watch for updates, may not be available on Xbox 10/2023. The ability to build a Jack-o-turnip should trigger upon picking up or harvesting a turnip. For Xbox, it may be necessary to download 'Insider Hub' through the console.

## Notes

• Jack-o-turnips do not frighten Boars when nearby, unlike most light sources.
